description: Labeled clone-detection benchmark corpus for drift:ai near-duplicate engine evaluation. Function references use the `<corpus-relative-path>#<functionName>` form. Labels are engine-agnostic ground truth: clonePairs are genuine clones, nonPairs are genuine non-clones. The `category` tags the clone type so an evaluator can report recall per kind. The current ts-morph engine is expected to recover exact/renamed/reordered pairs and to MISS extracted-helper and semantic (same-behavior, different-structure) pairs; future engines (tasks 41a-41c) can be scored against the same labels.

clonePairs.note: Byte-identical body, only the function name differs.
Same structure with every local and parameter renamed.
Same independent statements emitted in a different order, with renamed bindings.
One inlines the accumulation loop; the other delegates it to the `accumulate` helper. Statement structure diverges.
Same behavior (first-seen de-duplication), different structure (Set vs. nested membership scan).

nonPairs.note: Comparable size, no shared logic or domain.
Mostly identical shape but combine per-axis deltas differently (sum vs. max), so they compute different metrics.
